issues: React hydration warning: <span> child inside <option> caused by Emergent preview's x-ve-dynamic injection. Cosmetic only; already noted in iteration_3 report.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~937 lines with PayPal routes added — splitting into routers (auth, payments, generations, sources, jurisprudences, admin) is increasingly warranted for maintainability.
paypal_service.is_payment_acceptable correctly checks payment_status=Completed, receiver_email match (anti-spoof), mc_currency match, and mc_gross >= expected (0.01 tolerance). Solid.
verify_ipn re-POSTs raw body to PayPal with cmd=_notify-validate — correct per PayPal spec.
build_checkout_url formats JPY as integer (no decimals) — correct (PayPal does not allow JPY decimals). Other currencies use 2 decimals.
PUBLIC_APP_URL is used for notify_url (so PayPal can reach the IPN endpoint over the internet). Falls back to origin_url if missing — acceptable.
Webhook is idempotent: checks payment_status=='paid' before re-processing. Good.
Webhook only flips paid=true on (1) PayPal-VERIFIED + (2) receiver_email match + (3) currency match + (4) amount >= expected. Strong defense against spoofing.
Note: requests library is sync; verify_ipn is correctly wrapped in asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking the event loop.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL: https://formation-finances.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin is VIP=true (created in bootstrap), so /preview/{gen_id} is auto-unlocked for admin → no paywall button. To exercise the paywall UI, register a new user via POST /api/auth/register, then insert a generation in MongoDB owned by that user_id with paid=false. Frontend stores JWT in localStorage key 'vf_token' (NOT 'vitaform_token'). Login form is at /auth (not /login), opened via 'Connexion' button. Frontend already correctly issues POST /api/payments/checkout and redirects window.location to the PayPal URL. The IPN webhook test for unknown txn returns status='invalid' (PayPal verify rejects fake payload) — that is expected behavior, not a bug.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. PayPal _xclick flow is fully wired: backend builds the correct hosted-button URL (with merchant_id, business email, currency, amount, custom=txn_id, notify_url), persists a payment_transactions row, and the webhook performs anti-spoof validation before flipping paid=true. Stripe code is fully removed (webhook returns 404).
